package valuestore

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/hooks"
	"example.test/httperr"
	"example.test/store"
)

func teamFigure() []int { return []int{2} }

type Handlers struct{}

// A builder holds what is written into it, so a figure written there is in
// what it answers.
func (h Handlers) GetABuilderHoldingAFigure(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out strings.Builder
	out.WriteString(strconv.Itoa(teamFigure()[0]))
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out.String())
}

// A row scan fills what it is handed with what it read.
func (h Handlers) GetAScannedFigure(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var total int
	store.Scan(&total)
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, total)
}

// A callback the walk cannot run may fill its outer variable at any time.
func (h Handlers) GetAFigureFilledLater(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	names := auth.Catalog()
	hooks.OnReady(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		names = []string{strconv.Itoa(teamFigure()[0])}
		return nil
	})
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, names)
}

// A helper that writes a figure into what it is handed changes it.
func fill(names []string) { names[0] = strconv.Itoa(teamFigure()[0]) }

func (h Handlers) GetAFigureFilledInPlace(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	names := auth.Catalog()
	fill(names)
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, names)
}

// The request, and what it is turned into, carries no one's figure.
func (h Handlers) GetTheRequestBack(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"path": r.URL.Path, "query": r.URL.Query().Encode()})
}

// Nor does the catalog written through a builder.
func (h Handlers) GetTheCatalogBuilt(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out strings.Builder
	out.WriteString(strings.Join(auth.Catalog(), ", "))
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out.String())
}

// A helper that stores a figure and then refuses still leaves it stored.
func fillThenRefuse(out *[]int) error {
	*out = teamFigure()
	return errors.New("refused")
}

func (h Handlers) GetAFigureStoredBeforeARefusal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out []int
	if err := fillThenRefuse(&out); err != nil {
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
	}
}

// So does a literal that stores into its frame and then refuses.
func (h Handlers) GetAnOuterFigureBeforeARefusal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	names := auth.Catalog()
	if err := func() error {
		names = []string{strconv.Itoa(teamFigure()[0])}
		return errors.New("refused")
	}(); err != nil {
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, names)
	}
}

// What middleware put in the context, another service answered, or a
// callback yielded is no transform of the request.
func (h Handlers) GetFromTheContext(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, r.Context().Value("figure"))
}

func (h Handlers) GetFromAnotherService(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	answer, _ := http.Get(r.URL.Path)
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, answer)
}

func (h Handlers) GetFromACallback(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, slices.Collect(func(yield func(int) bool) { yield(teamFigure()[0]) }))
}
